plugin.name: Book Review Helper
plugin.description: Automatically extracts book reviews from Daily Notes and creates dedicated notes in the Books Read folder
plugin.author: Harry Guinness

plugin.commands.name: onEditorWillSave
plugin.commands.description: Processes book reviews when a Daily Note with #bookreview is saved

plugin.commands.name: Extract Book Review
plugin.commands.description: Manually extract a book review from the current note

plugin.settings.title: Book Review Folder
plugin.settings.description: The folder where book review notes will be saved (e.g., '30 - Resources/Books Read')
